purpose: Attribute direction at the composite-key level and close the explicit SHORT-side gap without inventing synthetic coverage.
directive: For each (target_bucket, pair, session), document existing LONG behavior, missing SHORT behavior, and whether SHORT can be derived from existing assets or must be regenerated from source/replay.

required_inputs.role: Baseline combo list and directional gap counts
Portable seed assets for attribution candidates
Directional signal candidates for Entry mapping
Directional signal candidates and supporting diagnostics
Replay dependency linkage when regeneration is required

study_questions: What LONG behavior already exists for each (target_bucket, pair, session)?
What SHORT behavior is missing for each (target_bucket, pair, session)?
Can missing SHORT be derived from existing assets without replay regeneration?
If not derivable, what replay/source regeneration path is required?

expected_outputs.description: Per-combo attribution decision with explicit SHORT status and evidence
Optional resolved direction map for downstream mapping generation

pass_when: Every resolved (target_bucket, pair, session) combo has explicit LONG and SHORT status entries in results.
Every missing SHORT case is marked as one of: DERIVABLE_FROM_EXISTING, REQUIRES_SOURCE_REPLAY, or UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM.
Every status is backed by at least one concrete source path in evidence_assets.
No result row claims observed SHORT behavior without source evidence.
fail_when: Any combo is marked SHORT_PRESENT without evidence.
Any key violates required order/field policy.
Any unresolved key is silently dropped instead of flagged.

direction.handling: Carry as UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM until attributed or replay-resolved

target_bucket.handling: Do not infer; keep unresolved until upstream bucket evidence exists

session.handling: Normalize and recover from upstream metadata when possible

first_execution_steps: Load control/pc2_segmentation_gap_report.json and extract short_direction_gaps.examples as the primary work queue.
For each queued (target_bucket, pair, session), gather LONG evidence from entry/aee grouped reports and phase2/phase6 source assets.
Attempt SHORT derivation using existing asset families and replay bridge manifests; record explicit derivation basis or replay requirement.
Write per-combo decisions into control/direction_attribution_results.json using required_key contract and explicit status enums.
Run pass/fail checks from this study definition and block completion if any fabricated or unsupported SHORT claim exists.
